note: The island's ambience (docs 17 and 25; src/audio/ambience.js). It reads the sound state about ten times a second and turns it into the level, tone and season blend of each bed, plus a seeded scatter of small one-shot sounds around the camera target. INPUTS that curves can read (all 0..1 unless said): still, slow, running = water of each kind within 12 m of the camera target; water = the most of the three; tideHigh = 1 at high water, 0 at low; lowTide = 1 - tideHigh; rising = 1 while the tide rises; wind, gust; hour = display time mapped onto a standard day where sunrise is 6 and sunset 18 (so one curve fits long summer days and short winter ones); height = camera height above the target in meters; rain = rain falling (0 in winter, where it becomes drizzle); drizzle; under = 1 underground (a zone below the island, src/world/zones: the spring's cave), where every bed but the trickle falls away and the one-shots stop; rainOnset = 1 as rain begins, fading over rainMemory onsetS (real seconds, so at any speed; the rain beds come in 12 dB down and ease up over it, and all sit 6 dB under their first level since October 21, 2026, as rain is not drawn yet and must never startle); afterRain = 1 just after rain stops, fading over afterRainS; mist; frost; life; nearWater, nearPads, nearReeds, nearGrass = what is close to the camera (from the state's surfaceNear if given, otherwise guessed from the water), pulled toward an even wash as the camera rises (surfaces.mergeHeightM, mergeTo); spring, summer, autumn, winter = the season weights. VALUES: a plain number; {in, pts} a curve of one input through [input, value] points, flat past the ends (log: true for frequencies); {bySeason: [spring, summer, autumn, winter]} blended by the season weights; {sum}, {mul}, {max}, {min} of other values. BEDS: each bed is a slot (src/audio/ambience/slot.js) that plays recordings from assets/audio/beds/<layer>/<season>-a.ogg and -b.ogg (season left out for all-season beds) once they exist and are listed in assets/audio/beds/takes.json, and the fallback made in code until then. gainDb values are added (decibels relative to the fallback as made), amount values multiplied; params go to the fallback bed (wind strength and gust, lap liveliness, rain amount and so on); lowpassHz is the bed's own tone (water opens as the camera comes close). seasonal beds keep one take per season and crossfade by the season weights. slot: recordedDb is the level of a recording against the fallback, idleStopS frees a bed silent that long, crossfadeS fades a recording in over its stand-in and one season into the next, takeSwap leans take a or b forward every everyS seconds over fadeS without letting the other drop below floor; rampS is how fast bed levels follow the state (doc 17: 0.8 to 3 s). FALLBACKS: the made-in-code stand-ins that src/audio/procedural.js does not make itself. surf is the sea: a deep body (lowpass hz from calm to windy, q, db, noise rate) and a higher wash band, waves every everyS seconds (faster by rateAtSwell from calm to big swell) rising over riseS and falling over fallS from a floor to peak, the wash swelling washExtra as much; levelDb overall. reeds and grass hold one EQ per season for wind through them (highpass, a peak, lowpass, db) and a rustle layer (bandpass hz and q, db at full wind, a flutter of depth flutter every flutterS seconds, noise rate); the seasons follow doc 25's matrix (reeds green and soft, full and velvet, gold and crisp, bare and hollow; grass fresh, a long tall swish, dry and scratchy, short and quiet). rain holds each surface (open water, lily pads, reeds, grass) and the winter drizzle: a noise texture (highpass, peak, lowpass, db at full rain, rate, a slow level wander) and drops (per second from light to full rain, bubble size mm, level jitter, a lowpass that dulls them; pads use larger, duller drops for a tap); seasons overrides one season's settings. run is a stream run: a band of moving water (bandpass hz, q, lowpass, db, rate, wander) over the procedural trickle's bubbles (amount from a slow to a full run). MIST (doc 25): the whole ambience is lowpassed from 18 kHz to about 7 kHz at full mist, its stereo width narrowed by widthCut (30 percent) and one-shot density cut by oneShotCut (a third). The extra 0.1 reverb send doc 25 asks for needs a mixer hook and is future work. WIDTH: stereo width of the ambience by camera height (narrower as it rises into a wide wash). FROST: a high shelf at hz over the whole ambience, cut by db with frost (doc 17's hushed frosty mornings; the game's frost input already burns off as the day warms). LEVEL: the overall ambience level by hour (the pre-dawn quiet, the night dip, easing up over about twenty game minutes at dawn). SURFACES: defaults for nearPads and nearReeds when the state does not give them. RAIN MEMORY: when the state does not give afterRain and rainOnset, the ambience keeps them itself in real seconds: onsetS of first drops, afterRainS of drips after rain ends (doc 25 asks for one to two game hours; the game should pass afterRain from its weather once it has one). ONE-SHOTS: each pool fires sound (a procedural one-shot: drop, plop, knock with kind, frostTick, crackle, aeolian) at ratePerMin times the product of rate values, never within minGapS of its own last nor within globalGapS of any other, at a seeded spot ringM meters from the camera target and heightM above it, at a gainDb picked in range, with sizeMm or durationS picked in range and an optional lowpassHz to dull it. density scales every pool by camera height. lookAheadS schedules a little ahead on the audio clock. spatial is the placement of one-shots (doc 17): inverse distance from refDistance with rolloff, an air-absorption lowpass from nearHz at nearM to farHz at farM. seed: the sub-seed for this system's streams. seasonEdge: when the state gives no seasonBlend, the season weights are made from season and seasonPhase, crossfading over this share of a season centred on each boundary (0.286 = the last day of one season and the first of the next, doc 25).

falls.note: Waterfalls (src/audio/ambience/falls.js; M2 Cliff tool, docs/07). The game passes the falls nearest the camera target (audio/game.json falls); each of up to `voices` gets a voice placed where it falls, made in code. Loudness: a fall's power is flow (m3/s) x height (m); at refPowerM4s it plays at dbAtRef, 10 dB per tenfold, held within dbRange. Distance from the camera target: full within distance.refM, then refM / d, fading to silence from fadeFromM to reachM; heightDb dims it as the camera rises, like the beds. air: the dulling with the eye's distance (spatial.js). Layers: hiss, pink noise above highpassHz through a band of quality q that rises from hz[0] for a drop of heightM[0] to hz[1] for heightM[1], at db; roar, slower pink noise (rate) under lowpassHz, its tone wandering wanderCents over wanderPeriodS, at db times a share that grows with power from fromPowerM4s[0] to [1], so only big falls rumble; splash, the procedural trickle's bubbles at amount[0] for a small fall to amount[1] for a big one. surge: the whole fall swells by depth over periodS. A voice keeps to its fall while the fall stays within matchM of where it was; changes glide over rampS; a new fall is heard only once it has run confirmS seconds, and then fades in over fadeInS (October 21, 2026: a spill that came and went, a wave over a step or rain brimming a terrace, burst in as a few seconds of loud hiss); a voice with no fall for idleStopS stops. The stream beds (trickle and run) dip under a loud fall (gainDb `fallLoud`, the loudest fall's level at the target, 1 = dbAtRef).
